Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse NpcAppearance

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NpcAppearance
public final class NpcAppearance extends Object
The client-visible state flags of an NPC — everything carried in entity metadata rather than in a dedicated packet.

Grouping these into one immutable value keeps an NPC update to a single metadata packet: the engine diffs the old appearance against the new one and sends only what changed, instead of one packet per setter call. That is the difference between a few hundred packets and a few thousand when a scripted NPC toggles several flags in the same tick.

Some flags are advisory on a packet-only NPC and are documented individually where that is the case. Build instances with builder(); DEFAULT is a plain, visible, non-glowing NPC.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • glowColor

      public Optional<net.kyori.adventure.text.format.NamedTextColor> glowColor()
      Returns the colour of the glowing outline.

      Colouring a glow requires the entity to be a member of a scoreboard team whose colour is set, so the engine maintains one team per colour it is asked for. An empty value means the client's default white outline, which needs no team at all.

      Gibt zurück:
      the glow colour, or empty for the default white outline

    • invisible

      public boolean invisible()
      Returns whether the NPC's model is hidden.

      An invisible NPC still receives interactions, which is how a bare hologram with a clickable hit box is built.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if invisible

    • collidable

      public boolean collidable()
      Returns whether players collide with the NPC.

      Collision is a client-side decision driven by scoreboard team membership, so enabling it puts the NPC into a team with pushOtherTeams behaviour. Disabled by default: an NPC that can be shoved out of position is the single most common complaint about NPC plugins.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if players collide with the NPC

    • gravity

      public boolean gravity()
      Returns whether the NPC is affected by gravity.

      Only meaningful for NPCs backed by a real server entity. Packet NPCs never move on their own, so for them this flag is recorded and ignored.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if gravity applies

    • silent

      public boolean silent()
      Returns whether the NPC suppresses its ambient and hurt sounds.
      Gibt zurück:
      true if silent

    • invulnerable

      public boolean invulnerable()
      Returns whether the NPC ignores damage.

      A packet NPC cannot be damaged in the first place; this flag decides whether an attack is reported as a NpcDamageEvent or only as an interaction.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if invulnerable

    • listedInTablist

      public boolean listedInTablist()
      Returns whether a player NPC appears in the tab list.

      Player NPCs must be announced to the client through a player info update before their spawn packet, or the client renders nothing. Leaving them listed afterwards is a separate choice, and is off by default because a hundred NPCs in the tab list is rarely wanted.

      Ignored by non-player NPCs.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if the NPC stays listed in the tab list
